It defines three levels: Level 1 (15 basic safeguarding requirements from 48 CFR 52.204-21), Level 2 (the 110 security requirements of NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2) and Level 3 (24 enhanced requirements selected from NIST SP 800-172).
REQUIREMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Conduct penetration testing at least annually or when significant security changes are made to the system, leveraging automated scanning tools and ad hoc tests using subject matter experts.
STATUSEXTENDED: Manual check
